title: Add onboard contract linter and compact impact-digest generator
author: Nina Alvarez
description:
Motivation: several recent model onboardings caused silent regressions (latency spikes and token-cost regressions) because metadata contracts and performance-profile deltas were not validated at PR time. This PR adds two things: (1) an onboard contract linter that enforces required metadata fields + semantic rules for performance profiles; (2) a compact impact-digest generator that computes a human-readable summary of deltas between the incoming model profile and the baseline used in production and emits an artifact that can be attached to PRs and release notes.

Design summary: the linter runs as a new CLI subcommand (registryctl lint-onboard) and as a GitHub Action job. Rules include: required metadata keys (family, architecture, tokenizer, sequence_length_bounds), semantic constraints (profile.sample_size >= 1000 for latency snapshots, cost_estimate present when quantization changes), and compatibility checks (alias mapping to canonical model names). The impact-digest computes: delta p50/p95 latency, expected tokens/second, estimated per-1M-token cost delta (based on the cost model in infra/costs/), quality-affordance flags (if eval_set accuracy decreased by >1.5%), and a compact human summary. When thresholds are exceeded the digest includes automated guidance (e.g., recommend quantized variant, fallback routing).

Implementation notes: added registryctl linter (pkg/registryctl/cmd/lint_onboard.go), a canonicalizers package (pkg/registry/alias_canonicalizer.go), an impact engine (pkg/onboard/impact_digest.go) with a simple delta scorer and markdown/JSON renderers, a new GitHub Action (ci/onboard-lint.yml) that uploads the digest artifact, and a release-note hook (scripts/release/attach-impact.sh) used by the changelog automation to embed the digest snippet. The JSON artifact is compact (keys: baseline, candidate, metrics_delta, recommendations) and the renderer also produces a short markdown summary under artifacts/impact-digest.md.

Backward compatibility: the linter is permissive by default (warnings do not block merge) except for a small set of enforcement rules that historically cause regressions (missing family, missing runtime profile). The team can flip enforcement flags with a config file (registry/.onboardrc). The CI job is gated behind a feature flag (env.ONBOARD_LINT_STRICT) until the next release window.

Testing and rollout: unit tests for the delta scorer and canonicalizer added (internal/tests/onboard_digest_test.go). Integration job added to the GitHub Action matrix that runs a synthetic compare with a representative baseline model. Rollout plan: stage to the model-registry main branch for two weeks (opt-in via label), then enforce strict mode for new onboard PRs after no regressions are observed.

Why this is different: this pairs a metadata contract validator with an actionable, compact digest that surfaces the concrete operational impact (latency/cost/accuracy) to release notes and reviewers. It is explicitly designed to reduce blind rollouts and make changelog automation more informative.

release_notes:
- Introduce 'registryctl lint-onboard' to validate model onboard manifests and performance profiles at PR time.
- Add an automated impact-digest artifact (JSON + markdown) that summarizes latency/cost/accuracy deltas and provides rollout guidance.
- CI job 'onboard-lint' uploads the digest for reviewer inspection.
- Feature flagged strict enforcement; default is permissive warnings for legacy manifests.
notes_for_engineering:
Follow-up work: (1) add a telemetry hook to record digest deltas for regression monitoring, (2) wire the digest to the rollout policy engine to block canary rollouts above thresholds, (3) add a lightweight visual in the Console release notes panel.
Owners: @ninal (onboard linter), @ethanc (impact scoring), @priyam (release integration).
manual_test_instructions:
1) Checkout branch feature/onboard-contract-lint-impact-digest
2) Run: go test ./... && registryctl lint-onboard path/to/candidate_manifest.yaml
3) Run: registryctl render-impact --baseline baseline.json --candidate candidate.json --out artifacts/impact-digest.json
4) Inspect artifacts/impact-digest.md and artifacts/impact-digest.json for expected metrics and recommendations
5) Toggle enforcement: copy registry/.onboardrc.example -> registry/.onboardrc and set strict_rules=true to enable blocking enforcement
